page4_s1.raw_text: New York State law now requires insurance companies to include Supplemental Spousal Liability insurance coverage on all automobile insurance policies unless the insured elects, in writing, to decline and refuse such coverage.

page4_s2.raw_text: Supplemental Spousal Liability insurance provides bodily injury liability coverage under a motor vehicle insurance policy when a person is injured or killed in a motor vehicle accident caused by the negligence of the person's spouse. This coverage is included within the policy's bodily injury liability limits and does not increase the amount of those limits.

page4_s3.raw_text: If you decline this coverage, then the injured or deceased spouse would not be covered under the bodily injury liability coverage in the policy. If you would like Supplemental Spousal Liability insurance coverage added to your policy, no action is needed. If you would like to decline this coverage, you will need to sign this form.

page4_s4.raw_text: insurance coverage will be automatically added to your policy at an additional premium.

page4_s5.raw_text: I hereby decline supplemental spousal liability insurance.
